value.rationale: The full arbitrary-dimension chain-product class is a motivated unbounded family with nontrivial automorphisms. The theorem describes exactly which automorphism invariants two-variable counting logic recovers and gives an explicit bound. Rank and first-round ideal/filter counts fail to distinguish the two inequivalent vertices (0,2,1) and (1,0,2) in [2]×[3]×[4], whereas iterative refinement succeeds. It avoids the stronger, generally false identification claim.
